reviewOutcome: The official municipal GEO Santa Maria cadastral GIS was evidenced, but the current GeoMais public entry point did not provide an anonymous response. No safe native parcel ID-plus-geometry response, layer schema, or CRS was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was retained and runtime qualification remains held.

queryAndRequestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 401, zero-byte body; response included no-store and cleared the GeoMais identity-provider session cookie. No login or credential attempt was made.

HTTP 200 first-party informational page; describes municipal cadastral coverage and lot/block/property/building information, but does not expose a machine-readable parcel endpoint in the retrieved page.
HTTP 200 official GEO Santa Maria technical manual; documents cadastral lookup concepts and lot fields, but no directly usable anonymous API response was extracted.

cityOrLocalCustodian: The evidenced local custodian is Prefeitura Municipal de Santa Maria, through Secretaria de Município de Urbanismo e Projetos / Instituto de Planejamento de Santa Maria. The service description identifies GEO Santa Maria as a municipal GIS covering cadastral and cartographic information. No separate state or national parcel service was used as a substitute.
nativeFieldNames: The technical manual describes concepts such as cadastro imobiliário, inscrição imobiliária, código de cadastro, matrícula, quadra and lote, but no live response was obtained to verify exact API field names.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity only if independently verified
scopeLimits: The official page says coverage is the urban 1st District-Sede and some district seats; this is not evidence of complete municipality-wide parcel coverage.
No exact-point hit, map-extent miss, timeout, or login wall is evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The WUP point remains exactly [-29.6915141491841, -53.8250039928481] in latitude/longitude order.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
No parcel owner, address, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or contact fields were requested or retained.
No parcel sample GeoJSON was retained because no safe native ID-plus-geometry response was verified.
No registry, catalog, runtime configuration, queue, identity ledger, or global report was changed.
uncertainty: The public GIS may require a changed route, browser-generated session, or later anonymous access policy. The observed HTTP 401 responses establish current anonymous transport access failure only; they do not establish cadastral absence.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; no source integration or admission.
